title: Poster corner pin
description: Four corner handles project an original fluorescent poster onto an oblique concrete wall, with one action to restore its fit.
useCase: Place vector artwork on a photographed or rendered surface using direct corner manipulation rather than matrix fields.
interaction: Drag a poster corner, nudge it with arrow keys, or choose Fit to wall.
reducedMotion: Corner edits follow input directly. Fit to wall restores the exact target geometry without an animated warp.
limitations: Bounded corner movement also enforces a positive signed-turn margin to prevent concave, self-crossing or nearly collapsed quadrilaterals. Wall and poster are original SVG, including outlined lettering. No image upload or camera calibration.
look: Pale concrete wall in oblique perspective with a fluorescent yellow-green poster of heavy black block letters, small blue-ringed corner handles and a frosted fit button.
motion: Dragging or arrow-nudging a corner handle re-projects the whole poster through a four-point homography on every move, clamped to stay convex; the fit button restores it instantly.
adapt: `matrix` solves the homography from `points`; `project` and `path` map poster-space shapes, clipped by `clipArtwork`; `moveCorner` clamps each corner to a fixed box and keeps the quad convex. Replace `wall`, `fitted` and the `glyphs` artwork, then retune those boxes.
